reviews.name: Robyn
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with For-Tech Electric during the installation of our full-house generator. From start to finish, the office team provided outstanding service with clear, consistent communication every step of the way. The installers were friendly, professional, and always on time.
We were especially impressed with how For-Tech managed the entire process, including permitting and scheduling, which made the project completely stress-free for us. The cost was very competitive, well within the range of other quotes we received and even lower than some.
We would absolutely recommend For-Tech Electric and will definitely consider them for any future electrical needs. Thank you to the entire For-Tech team for making this such an easy and positive experience!

reviews.name: Nicholas B.
reviews.text:
I was extremely happy with my choice of For-Tech for the purchase and installation of my home backup generator.  From the initial salesman to the site survey to the electricians and plumbers who installed the equipment, the entire crew was very courteous and professional.  For-Tech handled the entire process from assisting in filling out the HOA forms to scheduling the town inspections.  It all went off without a hitch and without any aggravation on the part of this customer.  Their pricing was fair when compared to other estimates I had received and their professionalism was unsurpassed.  A special shout out to Rachel who kept us completely and regularly informed throughout the process. She was a pleasure to work with.

I would not hesitate to call on For-Tech for any future needs.

reviews.name: E B.
reviews.text:
For-Tech came highly recommended by several friends.  Going in there was slight hesitation as it was from the higher quotes.

For-tech is superior in every aspect of their business.
Don't think twice
Make the call
You will thank me

reviews.name: Mike A.
reviews.text: Chose For-Tech to install whole-home generator. Very, very positive experience. Everyone from the initial contact to the final installation was extremely pleasant and professional. Rachel kept me informed of every step. The techs were always on-time, knowledgeable, and very pleasant. Great to do business with.

reviews.name: John A.
reviews.text: I have a Generac 16KW that I bought from an old man who had it in his garage for 10 years. I had it hooked up but 1st emailed Generac the serial number to see if it was covered under warranty. They said the unit was new and yes, it is! Well, It would crank but would not start. I called Generac and they highly recommended For -Tech. I called Rachael and she was excellent! Within 2 days they were at my home in brand new trucks loaded with parts. Within 2 hours he was done and running like new! I THANK YOU! In this day and age getting someone to come out is so hard!
